title: VANDIRA State → Region → District → Assembly → Booth Intelligence
purpose: Connected hierarchical navigation from Uttar Pradesh state to region, district, Assembly constituency and source-dependent booth intelligence.
region_model: 18 conventional Uttar Pradesh administrative divisions mapped to the 75 districts represented in the canonical 2022 Assembly warehouse.
booth_rule: Assembly-level booth totals are retained from the verified warehouse; detailed booth records are source-dependent and may be preview/partial.
freshness: Current 2027 intelligence is not inferred from 2022 hierarchy data and requires fresh evidence.
guardrails: Do not represent partial booth previews as complete booth universes
